ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to College of ACES until business hours on Nov. 17, 2022. This section has a blended format in which part of the content is delivered in lecture and discussion, and part is delivered online. This course has a recommended placement score of 65%. For details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS.This class has combined evening exams from 7-8pm on Thursdays: February 16, March 23, and April 20, 2023.
